title: GitLab variables
description: Configuration variables for the GitLab DevSecOps and Git server.

GITLAB_VERSION.description: Specific version of gitlab to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

GITLAB_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for gitlab: 'libscript_native' installs into isolated versioned directories and 'system' delegates to the host OS package manager.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global unix socket to listen on

GITLAB_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port for GITLAB to listen on

GITLAB_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Address for GITLAB to listen on

GITLAB_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Unix socket for GITLAB to listen on

GITLAB_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading gitlab binary or archive artifacts.

GITLAB_LISTEN.description: Listen endpoint (address:port or socket) for gitlab.

GITLAB_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying gitlab available remote releases.
